name: c8i-48xl
description: c8i.metal-48xl - custom Intel Xeon 6 (Granite Rapids), single socket, SNC3
numa_mode: SNC3 - each of the 3 compute dies is its own NUMA domain, with its own L3 slice and 4 memory channels

confidence.numa_nodes: SNC3 is Intel's default on Xeon 6900P and is the mode AWS runs. 3 dies per socket => 3 NUMA nodes, 32 cores each.
confidence.cores_per_l3: SNC3 restricts L3 to each compute die: 96 cores / 3 dies = 32 cores per L3 domain.
